as_told.title: Eric Davis tells Congress the NHI are controlling disclosure

plain: At a closed-door session of the US Congress in 2025, a witness named Eric W. Davis is said to have stated that "the NHI are controlling disclosure", meaning that non-human intelligences themselves decide how much the public learns about them. Michels tells this himself on two occasions; in one he places Davis at the closed session alongside Luis Elizondo, a former official Michels elsewhere calls a whistleblower, and a researcher named Avi Loeb. In the other he names no hearing or other witnesses and says it is his favorite line from Davis, though he disagrees with him about a figure named Townsend Brown. If true, the timing of any public revelation would be out of human hands.
